the immutable record and PENDING state are flushed in sled before enqueue or buffer release
bucket key version etag stored size and sha256 are persisted with the state
metadata acknowledgement is durable and bound to the retained object receipt
one cleanup claim records revision canonical path device inode and manifest before unlink
unlink and parent fsync precede a durable DELETED tombstone retaining the cleanup claim
retry count error and PENDING resume state are compare-and-swap flushed
retry count error OBJECT_WRITTEN resume state and the original object receipt remain durable
the preserved retry resume state is consumed by a compare-and-swap flush
the preserved object receipt is required and no object PUT is allowed

forbidden_transitions.reason: metadata cannot be accepted without a durable object receipt
pending local evidence is never cleanup eligible
a durable object receipt never regresses to an upload state
object storage success is not a metadata acknowledgement
deletion requires an exact durable cleanup claim
quarantined evidence requires an explicit repair contract

invariants: A sealed TripleBuffer lease is not reusable until both the spool file and PENDING journal record are durable.
Every immutable identity includes tenant probe capture UUID manifest hash object key size hash time range and packet count.
A durable spool contains exactly one PCAP global header followed only by complete packet records.
Every local path is canonicalized beneath the configured spool root and symlinks are rejected before read upload or unlink.
OBJECT_WRITTEN requires a trusted SDK or HEAD receipt bound to the same key size and sha256.
Recovery from OBJECT_WRITTEN and its RETRY_WAIT derivative performs metadata work only and never uploads the object again.
Age disk pressure or METADATA_ACCEPTED alone never authorizes deletion; only an exact durable cleanup claim does.
Startup recovery and cleanup interruption reconciliation complete before a durable capture admission permit is issued.
Graceful shutdown order is capture stop final seal journal flush buffer release producer close uploader drain recovery stop.
Legacy entries are decoded deterministically and never gain deletion authority from absent fields.
